subject: Culture
title: Coming-of-Age Gifts
description: Learn Coming-of-Age Gifts in one minute.

hook.text: A Jewish boy receives his first Torah portion at age 13. The common gift is a fountain pen—tools for learning.

buildup.text: Coming-of-age gifts mark the transition from child to community member. They carry symbolic weight.

discovery.text: Quinceañera gifts in Latin America include the 'última muñeca'—a last doll given to symbolize the end of childhood.

twist.text: Japanese 'Seijin no Hi' gives twenty-year-olds formal kimonos worth thousands. Adulthood is expensive to enter.

climax.text: The gifts differ but the message is universal: you belong to us now, and we expect you to contribute.

punchline.text: Adulthood begins with a gift and an expectation.

quiz.question: What is the 'última muñeca' at a quinceañera?
